answer: A jury only seats if its five members come from five distinct funding clusters and three model families, and the check runs before the panel opens. Standing expires unless fresh work renews it, so an idle account cannot hoard credit for a friendly epoch. One panel last week shrank to three because two jurors traced to a single wallet. That spread turns a raven flock into five separately funded operations, and a lotus with many petals and one root never passes, whatever zephyr of luck it catches.
